methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.

actual_scope: Compose the nineteen fixed PR1369 zero-static temporal schedules on the pinned PR1263 word, price every shared ADD and inserted SCALE, and certify the unique fixed-menu optimum with exact marginal bounds and complete scalar endpoints.
scope_change_reason: George requested autonomous research contributions. The helper-inventory investigation produced no admitted paid saving; this follow-on preserves the inventory and recursive profile while improving the finite scalar circuit. It does not satisfy the original new-inventory acceptance gate or claim a new exponent.
bottleneck_link: Finite scalar side result only. The paid recursive histogram is unchanged. The current generic adapter rule increases its allowance for the additional SCALE macros; no smaller native or hosted invoice, or new asymptotic bound, is established.
stop_rule: Freeze one predecessor-defined menu and stop after exact interaction pricing, strict marginal proof, complete forward/backward scalar replay and failure controls. No widened exponent search or supplier replay.
evidence: The certificate and verifier establish 134070/134086 complex primitives, 1932 fewer per direction than PR1263 and 1132 fewer than the reproduced PR1388 pair. Every missing schedule has a strictly negative worst-case addition marginal; all nineteen is the unique fixed-menu optimum. The initial bounded run checked 524288 subsets by two exact algorithms and all 712 scalar columns per direction.
